items.t: ConocoPhillips (COP) Stock Could Be A Bargain After A 133% Run
items.sum: ConocoPhillips has delivered a powerful five year gain for shareholders. After a recent pullback, the live question is whether the current share price still lines up with what the business earns. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 133.1%, which puts real pressure on the idea that its earnings can comfortably support today’s valuation.
